items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 14 at 9:21AM AKDT until October 15 at 4:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph
expected.

* WHERE...City and Borough of Sitka, Prince of Wales Island, and
Western Kupreanof Island and Kuiu Island.

* WHEN...From 1 AM to 4 PM AKDT Thursday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down.
items.areas: City and Borough of Sitka; Western Kupreanof and Kuiu Island; Prince of Wales Island
items.instruction: Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued October 14 at 9:21AM AKDT until October 16 at 4:00AM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 50 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Annette Island and Ketchikan Gateway Borough.

* WHEN...From 1 AM Thursday to 4 AM AKDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Highest wind gusts are expected Thursday night
into Friday. Gusts above 1000 ft may exceed 60 mph.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make travel difficult. Use extra caution.

Secure outdoor objects.

items.headline: Flood Watch issued October 13 at 10:20PM AKDT until October 16 at 1:00PM AKDT by NWS Juneau AK
items.description:
A stronger atmospheric river is expected to move over the panhandle
beginning early Thursday morning and continuing through at least
Friday morning. Multiple waves moving up will bring persistent
moderate to heavy rain for much of the southern half of the
panhandle. Past early Friday morning, additional periods of heavy
rain are possible, but confidence is moderate to low at this time.

river rises with the potential for at leas
